bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
svc=gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'USERBOT_RUNTIME_AUDIT_READBACK_BEGIN\n'
printf 'SERVICE_ACTIVE=%s\n' "$(systemctl --user is-active "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf 'SERVICE_ENABLED=%s\n' "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf 'SERVICE_SUBSTATE=%s\n' "$(systemctl --user show "$svc" -p SubState --value 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf 'SERVICE_RESTART_COUNT=%s\n' "$(systemctl --user show "$svc" -p NRestarts --value 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf 'SESSION_FILE=%s\n' "$(test -f deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session && echo EXISTS || echo MISSING)"
printf 'IPC_SOCKET=%s\n' "$(test -S deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock && echo EXISTS || echo MISSING)"
printf 'TOPIC_AUDIT_ACTION=%s\n' "$(grep -q '"topic_entry_audit"' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py && echo INSTALLED || echo ABSENT)"
printf 'AUDIT_CLIENT=%s\n' "$(test -f scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py && echo EXISTS || echo MISSING)"
printf 'ROLLBACK_FILES=%s\n' "$(find ../.userbot-topic-audit-rollback -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
printf 'HEALTH_CHECK_BEGIN\n'
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health 2>&1 | head -n 12
printf 'HEALTH_CHECK_END\n'
printf 'USERBOT_RUNTIME_AUDIT_READBACK_END\n'
